rules.title: Rules
rules.modeHint: Choose how much your AI tools may do without asking. You can change it any time.
rules.gitHelp: These rules ask before git commands that are likely to do damage: force pushes, pushes to main, rewriting history, deleting branches. A command that Manar cannot fully read also asks. A determined agent can still reach git through a script or another program, so protect your branches on your Git server too. JAIL (network limits) limits what a tool can reach.

watch.name: Watch only
watch.body: Record everything your AI tools do. Never stop them.

ask.name: Ask me for risky things
ask.body: Secrets, deleting files, force-pushing or pushing to main, rewriting git history, deleting branches and new websites wait for your yes. Everything else runs.

strict.name: Strict
strict.body: Anything outside the project folder waits for you. Secrets are always blocked.

rules.custom: You edited the rules by hand, so no mode is selected. Pick one to replace the start mode rules.
rules.failed: We could not change the start mode. Try again.
rules.loadFailed: We could not load your start mode.
rules.draftInvalid: We could not read the rule that was passed in, so the editor is empty. Nothing was saved.
rules.draftReady: This rule is pre-filled from your approval. Check it, then press Create to save it as a draft.
rules.grantsHint: Permissions that stop Manar from asking again. Withdraw one at any time; it applies from the next request.
rules.withdrawFailed: Could not withdraw. Nothing was changed.
rules.grantsLoadFailed: Could not load this. Permissions that skip the prompt may still apply.
rules.withdrawnNamed: Withdrawn: {tool} {action} in {scope}. Manar will ask again.

sample.title: Try with sample data
sample.body: Look around a pretend workspace with two devices, five AI tools and a week of activity. Nothing in it is real, and it never mixes with your own data.
